title: Explore a local calculation
fallback: This illustrative calculator doubles the entered value. Start at 21 to obtain 42; replace the formula and assumptions for the actual question.

props.html: 42
props.jsFunctions: function initialize(){const root=document.querySelector("[data-intelligent-ui-widget]");const input=root.querySelector("[data-input]"),output=root.querySelector("[data-result]");root.querySelector("[data-compute]").addEventListener("click",()=>{const n=Number(input.value);output.textContent=input.value.trim()&&Number.isFinite(n)?String(n*2):"Enter a finite number"});root.querySelector("[data-reset]").addEventListener("click",()=>{input.value="21";output.textContent="42"});root.querySelector("[data-discuss]").addEventListener("click",()=>Websandbox.connection.remote.sendPrompt({text:"Discuss this calculation: input "+input.value+", output "+output.textContent}));}
